tools.name: search_marketplace
tools.description: Search every live SalesGency product - GTM engines, agent skills, templates, bundles, sessions and subscriptions. Returns what each product is and does. Prices appear only at Stripe checkout; call create_checkout_link for a live payment link.

tools.name: get_marketplace_product
tools.description: Full detail for one marketplace product: what it includes, features, requirements and delivery. Price is shown at Stripe checkout - call create_checkout_link to get the live payment link.

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: Create a real Stripe-hosted Checkout link for a marketplace product. The link shows the live price and takes payment on Stripe. Hand the URL to the buyer - do not collect card details yourself.

tools.name: search_skill_packs
tools.description: Search the SalesGency standalone skill-pack catalog by text, category, kind or draft price tier. Checkout is unavailable.

tools.name: get_skill_pack
tools.description: Get one skill pack detail including file manifest, setup requirements, limitations and provenance.

tools.name: preview_skill_pack
tools.description: Return truncated SKILL.md and setup-prompt excerpts for a pack. Not a full archive.

tools.name: get_free_skill_pack
tools.description: Return download URL/resource metadata for the free ICP Brief skill pack. No email required.

tools.name: get_purchase_options
tools.description: Return draft prices and setup offer. Checkout is explicitly unavailable.

tools.name: retrieve_purchased_pack
tools.description: Entitlement-gated paid archive retrieval. Honors SKILL_PACK_PAID_DOWNLOAD_ENABLED; requires signed Bearer order capability. Disabled by default.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "retrieve_purchased_pack" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Entitlement-gated paid archive retrieval. Honors SKILL_PACK_PAID_DOWNLOAD_ENABLED; requires signed Bearer order capability. Disabled by default.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_free_skill_pack · Private data: get_skill_pack · Public sink: get_free_skill_pack.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_free_skill_pack · Private data: get_skill_pack · Public sink: get_free_skill_pack

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
